This specialization, combined with a strong narrative strength score of 95, makes it a focus for those tracking infrastructure development.

Before depositing funds, verify current CYS market availability directly in the exchange or DEX interface. Listings, liquidity, regional access, and withdrawal networks change over time, so treat venue availability as something to confirm at the point of purchase.

- Search for the exact CYS ticker and Cysic name.
- Confirm the trading pair, contract address, and network.

## Securing Your Tokens

Storing tokens on an exchange introduces custodial risk. For larger quantities, a hardware wallet is recommended to maintain self-custody. Always ensure your seed phrase is stored offline and never shared with unauthorized parties.
